summary: Context-only shadow deliberation: the blackboard remains risk-on while the US regime is low-confidence Q2/Reflation and transitioning. Risk Radar is calm and receding: its measured 21-day pullback rate is 13.0% versus a 17.8% base rate, so it is not an adverse edge. Breadth is healthy and volatility is normalizing, but market confirmation has no fresh internal chips. The principal restraint is orderly liquidity contraction, alongside restrictive real yields and an in-progress August inflation proxy indicating upward price pressure; that proxy is not an official CPI observation. Factor evidence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G records, no factor-attention track record, and no tradeable composite. No new hypothesis was staked because the available observations do not yet justify spending the weekly metabolism budget.
